//: Railpack decides install/build/start BEFORE this file is applied, so the
build and start commands are set on the service as RAILPACK_BUILD_CMD and
This file is the API service's config. When the worker and cron services
land they get their own, because only the API may run migrations.

build.//watchPatterns: Deliberately NOT set here. Config-as-code overrides the service setting, so keeping watch patterns in this file would mean a commit every time auto-deploy is toggled.

//preDeployCommand: Each platform's API service owns the migrations for ITS OWN database. The schema is shared code; the databases are not. The worker and cron services must never run this.

Invoked as a plain node path rather than through `pnpm run migrate:deploy`. Railpack's runtime image is not guaranteed to carry the workspace manifests, and a `pnpm --filter` that matches nothing exits ZERO on some versions — which would skip the migration and let the deploy go green against an unmigrated database. node either runs the file or fails loudly.
